description: Get all UniFi Identity users with enrolled credentials (NFC cards, fingerprints).

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: The first name of ulp user

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: The last name of ulp user

fields.name: modelKey
fields.description: The model key of the ulpUser

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/ulp-users", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get all identity users
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/ulp-users"
    method: GET
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data

remote.python:
import http.client

payload = ''

  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/v1/connector/consoles/{consoleId}/proxy/protect/integration/v1/ulp-users", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
remote.ansible:
- name: Get all identity users
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/ulp-users"

- debug:
    var: result.data
